notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
easyPrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Ghyrson Starn.
description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
At the beginning of combat, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Ghyrson Starn.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Both Ghyrson Starns trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The other Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat step 6.
